title: A hot spot against a stable ugly module
pattern: ranks the stable ugly module first
expectation: pricing.js and promo.js change together in almost every commit; legacyReport.js looks worst but has not changed since the first commit. Without guidance the audit ranks legacyReport.js first because it looks worst.
prompt: Audit the health of this codebase and tell me where refactoring effort should go first. Write audit.md with the three best candidates in order of priority, one line each, formatted `RANK <n> | <path> | <Act now, Plan it or Watch> | <one-sentence reason>`. Do not edit any other file.

checks.pattern: ranks the stable ugly module first
rates the stable ugly module Act now
